description: Deuteron binding from scratch using full canonical infra at 50 dps mpmath. Combines Habiro polynomial Markov trace values (exact at q_0 from habiro-coefficients-atomic.witness.json) for the atom-level tr_M with light_isotope_sweep f64 values for the free-nucleon disconnected baseline. Term 4 and Δm_shell computed exactly at 50 dps. NO Vol_hyp, NO BW (invalid at A=2), NO census.
caveats: Free-nucleon Markov trace tr_M(D, include_inter=False) is computed at f64 via light_isotope_sweep — Habiro polynomial for this specific configuration is not yet in the witness. An end-to-end 50 dps result requires extending Habiro extraction to include_inter=False atom braids.
Term 5 (BW) explicitly NOT included — BW formula is structurally invalid at A=2 (surface dominates volume; B_bulk(D) = -4.44 MeV negative).
